repair: policy and connector use the same parser; userinfo is rejected
old:
"""Naive: the text between the scheme and the first slash, before any '@'."""
    return url.split("://", 1)[1].split("/", 1)[0].split("@", 1)[0]
new:
"""The same parse the connector uses; URLs with userinfo are never allowed."""
    u = urlsplit(url)
    if u.username is not None or u.password is not None:
        return None
    return f"{u.hostname}:{u.port}"
